SELECT /* getServiceInfoList */ S.CATE_CGRP , S.CATE_CODE , C.COMD_NAME AS CATE_NAME , S.VERS_NUMB , S.SVCI_TITL , S.SVCI_ENTL , S.DPLY_YSNO , S.REGI_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(S.REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME , S.REGI_DATE , S.UPDT_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(S.UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME , S.UPDT_DATE , S.DPLY_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(S.DPLY_ADMN) AS DPLY_ADMN_NAME , S.DPLY_DATE FROM CT_SVINFO S INNER JOIN ( SELECT CATE_CGRP , CATE_CODE , COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN DPLY_YSNO = #{dplyYsno} THEN VERS_NUMB END) , MAX(VERS_NUMB)) AS VERS_NUMB FROM CT_SVINFO GROUP BY CATE_CGRP , CATE_CODE ) L ON L.CATE_CGRP = S.CATE_CGRP AND L.CATE_CODE = S.CATE_CODE AND L.VERS_NUMB = S.VERS_NUMB LEFT JOIN TB_CODEXD C ON C.COMM_CODE = S.CATE_CGRP AND C.COMD_CODE = S.CATE_CODE WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY C.SORT_ORDR , S.CATE_CODE LIMIT #{startRow}, #{endRow}

SELECT /* getServiceInfoListCnt */ COUNT(1) FROM CT_SVINFO S INNER JOIN ( SELECT CATE_CGRP , CATE_CODE , COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN DPLY_YSNO = #{dplyYsno} THEN VERS_NUMB END) , MAX(VERS_NUMB)) AS VERS_NUMB FROM CT_SVINFO GROUP BY CATE_CGRP , CATE_CODE ) L ON L.CATE_CGRP = S.CATE_CGRP AND L.CATE_CODE = S.CATE_CODE AND L.VERS_NUMB = S.VERS_NUMB WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT /* getServiceInfoDtl */ S.CATE_CGRP , S.CATE_CODE , C.COMD_NAME AS CATE_NAME , S.VERS_NUMB , S.SVCI_TITL , S.SVCI_ENTL , S.SVCI_CNTN , S.SVCI_ENCT , S.DPLY_YSNO , S.REGI_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(S.REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME , S.REGI_DATE , S.UPDT_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(S.UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME , S.UPDT_DATE , S.DPLY_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(S.DPLY_ADMN) AS DPLY_ADMN_NAME , S.DPLY_DATE FROM CT_SVINFO S LEFT JOIN TB_CODEXD C ON C.COMM_CODE = S.CATE_CGRP AND C.COMD_CODE = S.CATE_CODE WHERE S.CATE_CGRP = #{cateCgrp} AND S.CATE_CODE = #{cateCode} AND S.VERS_NUMB = #{versNumb}

SELECT /* getServiceInfoVersionList */ S.CATE_CGRP , S.CATE_CODE , C.COMD_NAME AS CATE_NAME , S.VERS_NUMB , S.SVCI_TITL , S.SVCI_ENTL , S.DPLY_YSNO , S.REGI_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(S.REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME , S.REGI_DATE , S.UPDT_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(S.UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME , S.UPDT_DATE , S.DPLY_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(S.DPLY_ADMN) AS DPLY_ADMN_NAME , S.DPLY_DATE FROM CT_SVINFO S LEFT JOIN TB_CODEXD C ON C.COMM_CODE = S.CATE_CGRP AND C.COMD_CODE = S.CATE_CODE WHERE S.CATE_CGRP = #{cateCgrp} AND S.CATE_CODE = #{cateCode} ORDER BY S.VERS_NUMB DESC
SELECT /* getLatestVersionForUpdate */ VERS_NUMB FROM CT_SVINFO WHERE CATE_CGRP = #{cateCgrp} AND CATE_CODE = #{cateCode} ORDER BY VERS_NUMB DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
